Figure 6. Two VTQFT diagrams that describe the same handlebody: one is in the sunset
OPE index contractions that we discussed in section 2. We highlight the distinction
between γ and γC because a mapping class γ does not change the topology of the
graph ΓC (instead, what changes is the embedding of ΓC in the Riemann surface).
On the other hand, γC can be any crossing transformation (in the Moore-Seiberg
groupoid), which may change the graph topology of ΓC.
An example at genus 2 will help to understand this point. In the dumbbell chan-
nel, the handlebody sum (3.46) should include the contribution from the mapping
class γ = S ◦S ◦F ◦B2 ◦F, whose VTQFT diagram is the linked dumbbell shown
in figure 6 (right). This is indeed a MCG transformation, and γC = 1. In the sunset
channel, on the other hand, we have γC = F, so the same handlebody is now repre-
sented by γ ◦γC = S ◦S ◦F ◦B2, where we used that F2 = 1. The corresponding
VTQFT diagram is shown in figure 6 (left). The two representations of the same
handlebody indeed lead to the same identity block:
